NDPS Act · Sentencing Aid Tool

Sentence Calculator

A structured tool to help legal practitioners compute indicative sentences under the Narcotic Drugs and Psychotropic Substances Act, 1985 — with aggravating and mitigating factors applied transparently.

Open Calculator

Available Tools

Sentence Calculator

Calculate indicative minimum and maximum sentences based on drug type, quantity, and prior convictions. Apply aggravating and mitigating factors and generate a structured report.

Sentence Comparison

Compare sentence outcomes side-by-side for two different scenarios. Useful when evaluating how changes in factors affect the final sentencing range.

About & Documentation

Learn how the calculator works, understand the underlying methodology, watch tutorial videos, and review important legal disclaimers.

Key Capabilities

Quantity-based sentencing

Supports small, commercial, and intermediate quantities for all scheduled substances.

Aggravating & mitigating factors

Apply weighted factors and see their cumulative impact on the computed sentence range.

Prior conviction tracking

Automatically accounts for repeat-offender provisions under Sections 31 and 31A.

Printable report

Generate a structured, court-ready summary of all inputs and computed outputs.

Side-by-side comparison

Compare two independent scenarios to evaluate the effect of changing key parameters.

Offline capable

All computation happens in the browser — no data is transmitted to any server.

!

Legal Disclaimer

This tool is intended solely as a computational aid for legal practitioners working under the NDPS Act, 1985. The values produced are indicative only and must not be used as a substitute for independent legal analysis or judicial reasoning. Courts retain full discretion in sentencing. Always verify results against the applicable statutory provisions and judicial precedents.
